title: FADED
text: FADED. When I received the product, it was beautiful. After just a few weeks I went to take it down and noticed it is faded. The detailing is gone, and the entire picture is faded, and all the color is gone. The product cannot be used again. I received it on or about the 5th of December. On the 28th of December the color was faded, I would not recommend this item as it did not even last a whole month.
